name: fs-design
description: Fair Supply's design suite for the FS-Luz system. Builds interactive prototypes of new designs from real Luz tokens and @repo/luz components — visually indistinguishable from production — and persists run feedback as learnings rules. Mirrors the full Impeccable capability set — shape, critique, audit, polish, normalize, harden, animate, and more — reinterpreted through the Pete/Petra/Esther product principles. Includes luz-lint enforcement.
